units: Aboth II, 6.—אף על פי (abbr. אע״פ) prop. even following the dictation of; אף על גב (abbr. אע״ג) prop. even on the top of, = notwithstanding, although (the former mostly in Mishnah, the latter in Gemara).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:1">Keth. V, 1</cite> <he>אע״פ שאמרו וכ׳</he> although the Rabbis have said; a. fr.—
Meg. 3ᵃ אע״ג דאיהו לא חזא although he does not see it; a. v. fr.—אף על פי כן nevertheless.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 16:13">Targ. O. Num. XVI, 13</cite>; a. e. V. <cite ref="A00796"><he>אוּף</he></cite>.
